records.detail: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand's own page on managing foreign reserves carries a section headed 'Bank of International Settlements (BIS) investment funds' which says that a small portion of the reserves portfolio is currently invested in investment funds managed by the BIS, and names three of them: the Asian Bond Fund, the Chinese Yuan Bond Fund and the US Dollar Green Bond Fund. It says the funds help diversify the foreign reserve portfolios while supporting the bank's other central banking objectives. No amount and no share of reserves is given anywhere on the page, and the record claims none. A separate Reserve Bank news item of September 2019 confirms the third of those holdings specifically, saying the bank funded its green bond investment from its foreign reserves portfolio and that the BISIP G1 invests in green bonds under the BIS Investment Pool structure.
records.source_title: Managing foreign reserves (Reserve Bank of New Zealand)
records.quote: invested in investment funds managed by the BIS
